assetOnboardingSourceFile.description: Latest uploaded asset hierarchy file or spreadsheet containing the entity.

configurationLastUpdated.description: Indicates when this asset was last updated in the asset configuration

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

dataValidationRuns.description:
All {@link DataValidationRun}s created for this asset.
Should be created using {@link DataValidationRuleset#validate}.
They are sorted in descending order of creation date, i.e. the latest
{@link DataValidationRun} will be the first entry in
this array.

latestDataValidationRun.description:
The latest {@link DataValidationRun}. Also, the first
element in the {@link dataValidationRuns} array.

datasetPreparationRuns.description:
All {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun}s created as a result of
calling {@link prepareMlDatasets} or {@link prepareMlDatasetsBatch}.
They are sorted in descending order of created date, i.e. the latest
{@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun} will be the first entry in
this array.

latestDatasetPreparationRun.description:
The latest {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun}. Also, the first
element in the {@link #datasetPreparationRuns} array.

datasetPreparationStatus.description:
Represents the current status of data preparation based on the {@link #datasetPreparationRuns}.
If there is a completed run, the status is COMPLETE. Otherwise, it is the status of the latest run.

targetTag.description: The {@link ExpectedSensor} that is the target of {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.SensorAssociation}.

sensorAssociationRuns.description:
All {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorAssociationRun}s created as a result of
calling {@link runSensorAssociationBatch} or {@link runSensorAssociation}.
They are sorted in descending order of created date, i.e. the latest
{@link ReliabilityAssetSensorAssociationRun} will be the first entry in
this array.

latestSensorAssociationRun.description:
The latest {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorAssociationRun}. Also, the first
element in the {@link sensorAssociationRuns} array.

inProgressSensorAssociationRuns.description: The {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorAssociationRun}s that have status `IN PROGRESS`.

sensorAssociationStatus.description:
Represents the current status of sensor association based on the {@link #sensorAssociationRuns}.
If there is a completed run, the status is COMPLETE. Otherwise, it is the status of the latest run.

acl.description: List of {@link AclEntry} entries governing who can read/update/remove Objs.

memberIntersections.description: References to MemberToEntity that map to this instance.

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

locationHistory.description: The historical location/address for the asset.

location.description: The current location/address for this asset.

realTimeLocations.description: Real-time location data for a moving asset.

denormAncestors.description: Ancestors in the asset hierarchy throughout history.

denormDescendants.description: Descendants in the asset hierarchy throughout history.

relativePositionHistory.description: The historical relative positions of this physical asset.

relativePosition.description: The current relative position of this physical asset.

measurements.description: Physical measurement series related to this asset.

pointMeasurements.description: Point measurement series for time-series metrics related to the asset.

events.description: {@link ReliabilityAssetEvent}s belonging directly to this asset.

childSensorRelations.description:
The {@link Sensor}s associated with this {@link PhysicalAsset}.

This field establishes the relationship between the physical asset and its associated sensors,
using a filter to only include sensors in the relation (where the type of relation is 'SENSOR').

timeToEventPredictions.description: The active {@link TimeToEventPrediction} objects directly belonging to this asset

eventCategoryRelations.description: The relations to {@link EventCategory} this asset has

assetClass.description: The {@link AssetClass} this asset belongs to.

hierarchyTemplateAssetId.description:
The id set by {@link AssetHierarchyTemplate} to identify this asset in relation to the template's hierarchy.
This id is unique within each hierarchy produced by a specific {@link AssetHierarchyTemplate} .

relDenormAncestors.description: All ancestors in the hierarchy throughout history.

currentRelDenormAncestors.description: All current ancestors in the hierarchy, excluding {@link Sensor}s.

currentAncestorsAndSelf.description: All current ancestors in the hierarchy and this asset.

relDenormDescendants.description: All descendants in the asset hierarchy throughout history.

currentRelDenormDescendants.description: Current descendants in the asset hierarchy, excluding {@link Sensor}s.

currentChildrenAndSelf.description: This field should be used instead of #currentRelDenormDescendants because {@link ReliabilityAssetHierarchyDenorm} isn't created for nodes without edges.

numCurrentDescendants.description: Number of current descendants in the asset hierarchy

currentChildren.description: The current direct children of this asset.

currentSensorHierarchicalRelations.description: Relations to {@link Sensor}s currently directly linked to this asset.

sensorHierarchicalRelations.description: Relations to {@link Sensor}s directly linked to this asset.

currentSensorDenormDescendants.description: Current descendants in the asset hierarchy that are {@link Sensor}s.

sensorRelations.description: All {@link Sensor}s ever clustered to this {@link ReliabilityAsset}.

currentSensorRelations.description: Current {@link Sensor}s clustered to this {@link ReliabilityAsset}.

depth.description: The depth of this asset in the hierarchy.

hierarchyClassification.description: A classification of what level of hierarchy this asset belongs to.

functionalLocation.description: A label for this asset which indicates the functional location/usage that this asset represents.

linked3DModel.description: The 3D model linked to this asset.

linked3DModelToDisplay.description: The 3D model linked to this asset, or the 3D model linked to the asset class if no 3D model is linked to this asset.

facilityRelations.description: All incoming {@link FacilityReliabilityAssetHierarchicalRelation}s, if any. Only relevant for the "top level" of the asset hierarchy.

currentFacilityRelations.description: Current incoming {@link FacilityReliabilityAssetHierarchicalRelation}s, if any. Only relevant for the "top level" of the asset hierarchy.

directWorkOrders.description: {@link WorkOrder}s belonging directly to this asset.

regionName.description: The name of the region this asset is related to.

members.description: List of {@link Member}'s linked to this {@link ReliabilityAsset}.

documents.description: All the {@link AssetDocument}s associated with this asset.

facility.description: The ancestor {@link Facility} associated with this {@link ReliabilityAsset}.

rootAsset.description:
Gets the ancestor root {@link ReliabilityAsset} associated with this {@link ReliabilityAsset}.
`currentRelDenormAncestors.(isRoot == true).distance` represents the depth of the ancestor.

parentAsset.description: Gets the direct parent associated with this {@link ReliabilityAsset}.

characteristics.description: Collection characteristic values associated with a given reliability asset.

assetImportanceLevel.description: The importance level of the asset, which is used to determine the asset's criticality.

currentModelRelations.description: All current model relations for this asset.

riskModelValidationRelations.description: All model validation relations for reliabilityRisk models for this asset.

currentReliabilityRiskModelRelations.description: All current model relations for reliabilityRisk models for this asset.

alerts.description: Alerts belonging to this asset and its descendant assets.

countOfLiveProjects.description: Count of projects that the {@link ReliabilityAssetToModelRelation}s with status 'CHAMPION' belong to.

reliabilityRiskModelRelations.description: All model relations for reliabilityRisk models for this asset.

totalModelCount.description: Count of #currentModelRelations. Models type or status not considered. Used in the UI.

modelRelations.description: All model relations for this asset.

latestAlert.description: Most recent alert belonging directly to this asset

directAlerts.description: Alerts belonging directly to this asset.

mutedModels.description: Count of champion {@link ReliabilityMlModel}s that are muted.

countOfProjects.description: Count of projects that the {@link ReliabilityAssetToModelRelation}s belong to.

numCases.description: Number of cases directly on this Asset

caseRelations.description: {@link ReliabilityAssetCase}s belonging directly to this asset.

numLiveModels.description: Number of live models for this asset.

reliabilityRiskLiveModel.description:
The live model associated with the {@link ReliabilityAsset}, derived from the current
`ReliabilityAssetToModelRelation` with a status label of 'CHAMPION'.

This retrieves the first (index 0) relation where the status is marked as 'CHAMPION',
indicating the active or leading model for the asset based on its project type.

lastModelSetupUpdateDate.description: Date of last update to model setup.

reliabilityRiskModelDeploymentStatus.description:
The deployment status of the Reliability Risk model for the {@link ReliabilityAsset}.
This field reflects the current deployment status of the risk model associated with the asset.
- If there is at least one model with a 'CHAMPION' status, it is considered a 'Live Model'.
- If there are no 'CHAMPION' models but at least one risk model exists, it is considered as 'No Live Model'.
- If there are no risk models associated with the asset, the status will be 'No Trained Model'.

numModels.description: The total number of current models (excluding retired) directly deployed on the asset.

numOpenCases.description: Count of OPEN {@link ReliabilityAssetCase}'s on this asset.

numLatestDirectAlerts.description: Count of all direct latest reliability risk alerts and sensor alerts in the last 24 hours.

pastMaintenance.description: List of all {@link WorkOrder} created for this asset in the last 30 days.

displaySensorMappingStatus.description: This field is used by the UI to show the translated value of {@link sensorMappingStatus}.

riskScoreIdCalc.description: Calc for the ID of the most recent risk score (an {@link ReliabilityExpressionEngineFunction#}getLatestRiskScoreId) associated with this asset.

numSensorFeatures.description: Number of sensors whose raw value can be used as features for this asset.

lastConfiguredReliabilityRiskModelDate.description: Last Configured Model Date for this {@link ReliabilityAsset}.

configurationLastUpdatedDate.description: Last update date, using `configurationLastUpdated` or fallback to `meta.updated`

assetLevel.description: The level of this asset in the hierarchy based on the calculated {@link #depth}.

anomalousPeriods.description: The {@link ReliabilityAssetAnomalousPeriod} to use when configuring a {@link MlModel}.

numOpenDescendentSensorAlerts.description: Count of open {@link SensorHealthAlert}s on the descendents of this asset.

numRetiredModels.description: Number of retired models for this asset.

riskScoreValueCalc.description: Calc for the value of the most recent risk score.

numRiskModels.description: Number of {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s currently deployed on this asset.

numWorkOrders.description: Number of direct work orders for the asset

displayedHighRiskThreshold.description: The risk score threshold for the asset to be considered as high risk. Used in the UI.

riskScoreValue.description:
The value of the most recent risk score
The Value for this field is generated via the {@link FieldStoredMetricCache} type and should
not be overwritten except for by that type.

modelConfigRunRelations.description: Model Config Runs for this {@link ReliabilityAsset}.

numLatestOpenAlerts.description: Count of open {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert}'s on this asset and its descendents in the last 24 hours

riskLevel.description: The risk level classification of the asset. Used in the UI.

directCases.description: {@link ReliabilityAssetCase}s directly associated with this asset.

riskScoreId.description:
The ID of the most recent risk score
The Value for this field is generated via the {@link FieldStoredMetricCache} type and should
not be overwritten except for by that type.

isSensorMappingComplete.description: This field indicates whether the mapping of {@link Sensor}s to a {@link ReliabilityAsset} has been completed.

mutedPeriods.description: The {@link AlertMutedPeriod}s associated with the {@link ReliabilityAsset}.

reliabilityRiskLiveModelName.description: Display name for the current live model

sensorMappingStatus.description: This field indicates the current status of the mapping of {@link Sensor}s to the {@link ReliabilityAsset}.

numOpenDescendentAlerts.description: Count of open {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert}s on the descendents of this asset.

numLatestOpenDirectAlerts.description: Count of open {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert}'s on this asset in the last 24 hours.

lastCorrelationModelSetupUpdateDate.description: Date of last update to model setup with correlation.

numLatestOpenSensorAlerts.description: Count of open {@link SensorHealthAlert}'s on this asset in the last 24 hours.

numOpenDirectAlerts.description: Count of open {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert}'s on this asset.

regimes.description: The {@link ReliabilityAssetRegime} to use when configuring {@link MlModel}.

numOpenSensorAlerts.description: Count of open {@link SensorHealthAlert} on this asset.

lastModelConfigStatus.description:
Latest Model Config Status for this {@link ReliabilityAsset}.

Checks if any of the model config runs are in progress.
If yes, returns 'IN PROGRESS', else returns the status of the latest model config run.

cases.description: List of all {@link ReliabilityAssetCase}s belonging to this and all child assets.

numOpenDirectChildrenAlerts.description: Count of open {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert}'s on this asset and its direct children.

lastModelConfigUpdateDate.description: Date of last model config update

numCandidateModels.description: Number of candidate models for this asset.

displayedMediumRiskThreshold.description: The risk score threshold for the asset to be considered as medium risk. Used in the UI.

plannedMaintenance.description: List of all {@link WorkOrder} created for this asset in the last 30 days.

failureModes.description: The {@link FailureMode}s associated with this asset through its {@link AssetClass}.

numOpenAlerts.description: Count of open {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert}'s on this asset and its descendents.

displayedRiskScore.description: Risk Score to display in the UI.

numChildModels.description: The total number of children level models (excluding retired) for the asset.

numOpenDirectCases.description: Open {@link ReliabilityAssetCase}s belonging directly to this asset.

numAllLatestAlerts.description: Count of all latest reliability risk alerts and sensor alerts in the last 24 hours.

sensorAlerts.description: Sensor alerts associated with this asset.

numChallengerModels.description: Number of challenger models for this asset.

daysSinceLastUpdatedReliabilityRiskModel.description: Number of days since the last updated model.

latestSensorAlerts.description: Sensor alerts in the last 24 hours.

title: Represents assets at all levels of the Reliability Asset Hierarchy except Facility. Acts as the node in the hierarchy denorm graph.
name: ReliabilityAsset
